title: Grilled Squid with Earthy Slovakian Skewers
description: A unique Italian-inspired dish featuring succulent squid and earthy Slovakian vegetables, perfect for a summer evening. Skewers are easy to make and can be customized with your favorite ingredients.

ingredients.name: slovakian sausage
ingredients.notes: you can substitute with any vegetarian sausage for a vegan option

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, and basil.
Add sliced onions and mushrooms to the bowl, toss to coat.
Thread onion and mushroom mixture onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Brush squid with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill squid for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Grill skewers for 5-7 minutes per side, or until vegetables are tender.
Serve squid with skewers and a side of your favorite pasta or salad.
